title: Add Propose Day note extension and proposing illustration on the Note screen

requirements.text:
Update the Note screen content to include the additional Propose Day message text exactly as provided, preserving line breaks and punctuation, appended after the existing note text:

"Happy Propose Day
Life will be more beautiful if you are with me."

quotes:
and again New Note:

Happy Propose Day
Life will be more beautiful if you are with me.

acceptanceCriteria: On the Note screen, the existing note text remains unchanged and still appears.

The Note screen additionally displays the two new lines exactly:
- "Happy Propose Day"
- "Life will be more beautiful if you are with me."
Line breaks are preserved (the two lines appear on separate lines).

requirements.text: Add a Propose Day themed illustration to the Note experience, matching this visual description: "A boy is wishing a girl Happy Propose Day while proposing to her, kneeling down on one knee." Render it as a static frontend image asset on the Note screen (no backend fetch).

quotes:
Description (scene):
A boy is wishing a girl Happy Propose Day while proposing to her, kneeling down on one knee.

acceptanceCriteria: A new image file is added under frontend/public/assets/generated and is referenced directly from the Note screen via a /assets/generated/... path.
The illustration is visible on the Note screen alongside the note text (not on the cover, question, or celebration screens).
The frontend does not fetch the illustration from the backend; it is served as a static asset.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI components are read-only).
Do not modify any paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths.
Backend remains single-actor in backend/main.mo; do not add additional backend services for this change.
Do not route images through the backend; render from static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated.
nonGoals: Changing the existing screen flow (Cover -> Note -> Question -> Celebration).
Changing the existing Valentine question text, the evasive No behavior, or the celebration "Good choice" meme screen.
Adding authentication, persistence, or any backend data model changes.

required: Romantic illustration of a boy kneeling on one knee proposing to a girl while wishing her Happy Propose Day, soft pink/romantic palette (propose-day-scene.dim_1024x768.png)
